scopes.common: Unlock key `id`. Once per run, any stack. XP counts toward the global ladder only.
scopes.per-stack: Unlock key `id@stack`. Earnable once in each stack, hands-on sessions only. Criteria use abstract `verify:` verbs resolved by stacks/<stack>/verify.yaml; a verb the pack does not define means: do not unlock.
scopes.stack: Unlock key `id@stack`. Defined in stacks/<stack>/achievements.json, earnable once, only in that stack, hands-on sessions only.
scopes.polyglot: Unlock key `id`. Once per run, needs 2+ stacks in play. XP counts toward the global ladder only.

achievements_total_derivation: Derived by award-xp, never hard-coded: count(scope common) + count(scope polyglot) + count(scope per-stack) x |stacks in play| + sum over stacks in play of count(stacks/<id>/achievements.json definitions). 'Stacks in play' = distinct `stack` values of the current run's sessions (java when none).

definitions.name: Pure Core
definitions.description: First aggregate and value object with enforced invariants, in the stack's baseline language step.
definitions.criteria: verify: day p1-end passes for the stack (the day's checklist covers the P1 aggregate and value object compiling/loading at the baseline language step) AND the recording session has stack=<stack>, mode=hands-on

definitions.name: Property Pioneer
definitions.description: First passing property-based test proving domain commutativity or invariance.
definitions.criteria: verify: property exits 0 for the stack AND the stack's property library (stack.yaml `property_lib`) is exercised by >=1 test in that stack's p[1-9] projects

definitions.name: Decision Anchor
definitions.description: First ADR whose consequences are spelled out and whose decision is exercised by a passing test.
definitions.criteria: curriculum/adr/ has >=1 file with a '## Consequences' heading AND some session records an adr_landing event citing that ADR

definitions.name: Hex Vex
definitions.description: Pass the stack's architecture-boundary test in P3.
definitions.criteria: verify: arch p3 exits 0 for the stack (the pack maps `arch` to its boundary tool, e.g. ArchUnit, NetArchTest, dependency-cruiser, import-linter, Packwerk)

definitions.name: Bounded
definitions.description: Aggregate root with enforced invariants AND property tests covering them.
definitions.criteria: p3 in the stack declares a type named as the aggregate root in its PLAN.md (stack.yaml `aggregate_marker` idiom) AND verify: property p3 exits 0 with >=1 property targeting that root's invariants

definitions.name: Outbox Hero
definitions.description: Transactional outbox loses no message under chaos test.
definitions.criteria: p5 in the stack has an outbox table migration AND verify: chaos p5 exits 0 (test survives a forced rollback with no lost message)

definitions.name: Idempotent Mind
definitions.description: Payment retry test passes 100x without duplication.
definitions.criteria: verify: idempotency p6 exits 0 for the stack, where the test loops 100 retries and asserts exactly-once application of a Payment

definitions.name: Contract Killer
definitions.description: First green provider or consumer contract test.
definitions.criteria: verify: contract p6 exits 0 for the stack (any green provider verification or consumer contract test: Pact, or Spring Cloud Contract for java)

definitions.name: Container Diet
definitions.description: App image under the stack's size budget.
definitions.criteria: verify: image-size p7 exits 0, i.e. the stack's image for any p7+ service is below stacks/<stack>/stack.yaml `image_size_max_mb`; if that key is absent, do not unlock

definitions.name: kubectl Karma
definitions.description: Full stack green on kind from a cold cluster.
definitions.criteria: kind cluster created then helm install completes AND kubectl get pods shows all Ready

definitions.name: Terraform Tamer
definitions.description: terraform plan is clean on the second run (no churn).
definitions.criteria: two consecutive terraform plans show 0 changes in envs/dev

definitions.name: LocalStack Whisperer
definitions.description: Full integration suite green against LocalStack.
definitions.criteria: p9 integration tests pass against envs/localstack

definitions.name: Chaos Survivor
definitions.description: Capstone chaos drill passes.
definitions.criteria: day-30 verification all_passed AND no payment lost in chaos run

definitions.name: Paper Trail
definitions.description: Ten learner ADRs with spelled-out consequences.
definitions.criteria: `grep -lE '^## Consequences' curriculum/adr/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-*.md | wc -l` >= 10 (template and README files do not match the NNNN-*.md pattern)

definitions.name: Fortnight
definitions.description: A 14-day streak, shields allowed.
definitions.criteria: streak_days >= 14 after the award-xp streak/shield fold over the current run's session dates (profile.json streak_days, recomputed this call)

definitions.name: Reflective
definitions.description: Thirty debriefs recorded.
definitions.criteria: count of 'debrief' entries in events[] across the current run's sessions/*.json (including the brief being processed) >= 30

definitions.name: Cartographer
definitions.description: Authored a masterplan that passes lint.
definitions.criteria: a curriculum/masterplans/<id>/masterplan.yaml exists with <id> not in {_template, loan-servicing} AND `node tools/masterplan-lint <id>` exits 0. Authorship is not machine-checkable: any non-template masterplan that lints clean counts. Never unlocks while tools/masterplan-lint does not exist.

definitions.name: Domain Hopper
definitions.description: Finished P1 in two different masterplans.
definitions.criteria: among the current run's sessions, those with verification.all_passed=true whose `day` equals the last day of spine slot p1 (curriculum/spine.yaml slots[p1].days[1]) carry >=2 distinct `masterplan` values (absent masterplan = loan-servicing)

definitions.name: New Game+
definitions.description: Started a fresh-start run.
definitions.criteria: profile.json prestige >= 1 (run >= 2) AND progress/archive/ contains a directory for the previous run

definitions.name: First Words
definitions.description: First hands-on day in a second stack.
definitions.criteria: the current run has hands-on sessions with verification.all_passed=true in >=2 distinct stacks

definitions.name: Rosetta Stone
definitions.description: Same spine slot completed hands-on in three stacks.
definitions.criteria: for some spine slot, the current run has hands-on sessions with all_passed=true on that slot's last day (curriculum/spine.yaml) in >=3 distinct stacks

definitions.name: Consensus
definitions.description: One shared vector file green in three stacks.
definitions.criteria: the same file under the masterplan's vectors/ directory is exercised and green via `verify: vectors <slot> <name>` in >=3 distinct stacks (run the verb in each stack's project now; hands-on projects only)

definitions.name: Contract Diplomat
definitions.description: A mixed-stack Pact (provider and consumer in different stacks) is green.
definitions.criteria: a Pact file exists whose consumer and provider projects resolve to different <stack> path segments (projects/p<N>-<slug>/<stack>/) AND `verify: contract p<N>` exits 0 on both sides. Depends on the Wave 4 `contract` verb: never unlocks until stacks/*/verify.yaml defines it.

definitions.name: Full House
definitions.description: P1 completed in all five stacks (hands-on or assisted).
definitions.criteria: for each stack id in {java,dotnet,node,python,ruby}, the current run has a session tagged with it, verification.all_passed=true, on the last day of spine slot p1 (any mode)

definitions.name: Comparative Critic
definitions.description: Five cross-stack comparisons with the reflection sections filled in.
definitions.criteria: `ls curriculum/comparisons/p*.md | wc -l` >= 5 AND in each of those, every '## Reflection' section has no remaining 'LEARNER:' marker and >=20 words. Depends on the Wave 5 /compare template; never unlocks if a file lacks a '## Reflection' heading.

definitions.name: Honest Numbers
definitions.description: Capstone benchmark measured in two or more stacks, hardware noted.
definitions.criteria: curriculum/comparisons/capstone-benchmark.md has measured result rows (numeric, non-placeholder) for >=2 stacks AND a non-empty 'Hardware:' line. Depends on the Wave 5 benchmark template; never unlocks without it.

definitions.name: Polyglot Architect
definitions.description: Every spine slot completed hands-on in two stacks.
definitions.criteria: for every slot in curriculum/spine.yaml (p1..p9 and capstone), the current run has hands-on sessions with all_passed=true on that slot's last day in >=2 distinct stacks
